They offer a broad range of bikes for all disciplines — from trail and e-MTB to road and kids — alongside a professional workshop, free e-bike demo rides, and cycle-to-work scheme support.

description.full:
Established in 2007, Evolution Bikes is one of North Wales' leading independent bicycle retailers, based in Bangor on Cyttir Lane close to the A55. Run by passionate cyclists, the shop places customer satisfaction at the centre of its business and stocks an extensive range of bikes from premium brands including Trek, Specialized, Cube, Merida, Scott, Whyte, Frog, Marin, and Amflow — covering road, gravel, mountain, hybrid, electric, and kids bikes.

The professional workshop team handles everything from routine servicing to complex repairs, with bookings available online. Evolution Bikes is a Trek preferred retailer and a registered Cyclescheme retailer, making it straightforward for employers and employees to spread the cost of a new bike through the government cycle-to-work scheme. Finance options of up to 36 months are also available in-store.

For those curious about electric bikes, the shop operates a free e-bike demo service at the Bangor site, allowing customers to test models before committing to a purchase. Accessories from Bontrager, Shimano, SRAM, Lezyne, Topeak, and Abus are also stocked alongside clothing and protective gear.

The shop is open Tuesday to Saturday, 9am to 5pm, and offers bike home delivery and click-and-collect services.
